description: Consumed fuel over the event trace
comment: Each total is measured from the start of evaluating the program expression: the program's entry region (the closure creation), the invocation event, and every region entry and event charge the invocation produces. Derivations are spelled out per case; see docs/runtime/execution-limits.md for the cost law.

cases.description: square: one invocation, one entry region, one builtin event
cases.comment: program entry region 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 2 (two $var) + mul builtin 1 = 5.

cases.description: branching charges only the selected arm: $then
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 2 + gt builtin 1 + selected arm region 1 = 6.

cases.description: branching charges only the selected arm: $else, same total by symmetric constants
size-metered builtin inputs and value production
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 2 + strcat builtin (base 1 + rest sizes 5 + 5) + produced string 10 = 25.

cases.description: string sizes are Unicode code points
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 1 + upper builtin (base 1 + 3 code points) + produced string 3 = 10.

cases.description: forcing a $let binding enters its region once; the memoized reread adds nothing
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 3 + binding region 2 + add builtin 1 + mul builtin 1 = 9.

cases.description: aggregation meters its array input; a scalar result produces no value charge
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 1 + sum builtin (base 1 + input length 4) = 8.

cases.description: callback traversal charges one event per callback call
cases.comment: program entry 1 + invocation 1 + body entry region 2 ($fn node + literal 3) + range builtin 1 + produced range array 3 + map builtin 1 + three neg builtin events 3 + produced map array 3 = 15.

cases.description: exhaustion is checked at event points: the size-metered builtin event exceeds the budget
cases.comment: Charges before the strcat event total 4; the event's 11 exceeds the remaining budget of 6.
